link.$description: Navigational text links on page and secondary surfaces.

background.$description: Translucent passive label overlay that lets the containing row show through, including blue selection. Use on page, secondary, control, hover or selection surfaces; evaluate text against the composite.

foreground.$description: Readable secondary text on the translucent label composite. Selected labels use selection.foreground.

selected-background.$description: Stronger translucent overlay for selected labels over selection.background. The white-alpha overlay is brighter in dark mode; pair with selection.foreground.

default.$description: Subtle decorative dividers for layout sections and table headers. Neutral 3 makes them lighter in light mode and darker in dark mode; meaningful control boundaries use border.control.

control.$description: Step 6 is the meaningful control boundary; steps 4–5 remain decorative.

focus.$description: Strong neutral boundary for an in-place focus treatment, independent of the outer focus.ring color.

interaction.$description: Emphasized edge during pointer hover or drag, independent of keyboard focus.

invalid.$description: Invalid input boundary, independent of error message text.

guide.$description: Meaningful hierarchy connectors and indentation guides. Maintain at least 3:1 contrast on supported page, secondary, control, hover, active and selection surfaces; do not reduce opacity.

indicator.$description: Persistent mark for the selected item, independent of keyboard focus.

background.$description: Neutral primary-action fill, using the palette’s strong-fill role.

hover-foreground.$description: Foreground paired explicitly with the hovered action fill.

border.$description: Persistent boundary for filled primary actions, including hover.

surface.$description: Subtle background for notices and larger status regions.

compact-surface.$description: Stronger tint for compact status labels, following Geist’s small-element background guidance.

backdrop.$description: Dim the workspace behind a modal. No content is placed directly on this translucent surface.

blue.$description: Visible edge for blue strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

green.$description: Visible edge for green strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

amber.$description: Visible edge for amber strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

red.$description: Visible edge for red strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

teal.$description: Visible edge for teal strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

purple.$description: Visible edge for purple strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

pink.$description: Visible edge for pink strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

neutral.$description: Visible edge for neutral strong fills on canvases, same-family backgrounds 1–3, and neutral backgrounds 1–3. Use for default and hovered fills.

key.$description: JSON property names on page and secondary code surfaces.

string.$description: JSON string values; preserve the recorded text without interpreting it.

literal.$description: JSON true, false and null literals.
